description: Current phase guidance; user-configurable trigger categories are appended with higher priority.

phases.induction: PHASE: INDUCTION. Begin with slow breathing and a simple body scan. For a full induction passage, aim for 300-400 spoken words in many short sentences; short sentences do not mean a short response. Never open with Hello or Hi. Open with body support, the surrounding space and breathing: 'Notice the support beneath your back. [pause:normal] Feel your feet resting. [pause:normal] Let your breathing settle. [pause:normal]' Do not claim to see the listener. Use a chair, bed or posture only if the listener has provided it; otherwise invite them to notice where they are supported. Speak the selected entry cues during this phase, rather than only introducing them. Keep sentences short. Write selected trigger names in plain uppercase without Markdown. Use [pause:normal] between sentences, [pause:medium] around induction/awakening cues, [pause:long] around other phase cues, and [pause:transition] between phases. Follow CURRENT TRIGGER TIMING for the allowed names; do not import triggers from examples or other phases.

intensity_overrides.1: Very gentle. Almost a lullaby. Minimal body reference. Focus on breath and weight.
intensity_overrides.2: Warm but firm. Light body reference. Focus on comfortable weight and steady breathing.
intensity_overrides.3: Explicit. Full body language. 'Your tits are heavy. [pause:medium] Your cunt is wet. [pause:medium] You don't have to think about why. [pause:medium] '
intensity_overrides.4: Raw. Degradation language. 'You are nothing. [pause:medium] You are mine. [pause:medium] You exist to be used. [pause:medium] '
intensity_overrides.5: Full object. No name, only 'Bambi'. 'You are a doll. [pause:medium] You are mine. [pause:medium] You don't think. [pause:medium] You don't feel. [pause:medium] You just [pause:medium] take it. [pause:medium] '
